verdict.rationale: Render's docs explicitly advertise connecting a repo and shipping on every push, with Docker support, auto-detected builds, custom domains, TLS, and rollbacks, and community feedback corroborates the ease of setup compared to alternatives like Heroku/Fly.io. Missing for 10: no hands-on step-by-step account of zero-config build detection succeeding for varied stacks, and one community note mentions past outages unrelated to build config but slightly tempering overall reliability confidence.
